name: glossa
description: Read books in the original with a parallel translation, word lookups and a personal vocabulary.

scripts.serve: npm run vendor && npx --yes http-server web -p 8080 -c-1
scripts.ios:add: npm run vendor && npx cap add ios && node scripts/ios-setup.mjs
scripts.ios:sync: npm run vendor && npx cap sync ios && node scripts/ios-setup.mjs
